mapper.sql: disposition_id, discrepancy_id, discrepancy_detail_id, shipment_detail_id, category, decision, quantity, cost_price, amount, inventory_impact, source_location_dept_id, target_location_dept_id, responsible_party, note, attachment_refs, request_id, handled_by_user_id, handled_by_name, handled_time, version
mapper.insert: insert into inv_transfer_discrepancy_disposition ( discrepancy_id, discrepancy_detail_id, shipment_detail_id, category, decision, quantity, cost_price, amount, inventory_impact, source_location_dept_id, target_location_dept_id, responsible_party, note, attachment_refs, request_id, handled_by_user_id, handled_by_name, handled_time, version ) values ( #{discrepancyId}, #{discrepancyDetailId}, #{shipmentDetailId}, #{category}, #{decision}, #{quantity}, #{costPrice}, #{amount}, #{inventoryImpact}, #{sourceLocationDeptId}, #{targetLocationDeptId}, #{responsibleParty}, #{note}, #{attachmentRefs}, #{requestId}, #{handledByUserId}, #{handledByName}, #{handledTime}, 0 )
mapper.select: select from inv_transfer_discrepancy_disposition where discrepancy_id = #{discrepancyId} order by disposition_id

select d.* from inv_transfer_discrepancy_disposition d inner join ( select discrepancy_detail_id, category, max(disposition_id) as disposition_id from inv_transfer_discrepancy_disposition where discrepancy_id = #{discrepancyId} group by discrepancy_detail_id, category ) latest on latest.disposition_id = d.disposition_id order by d.discrepancy_detail_id, d.category
